history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help?

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s service and picture messaging issues. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for the information. Your line is currently active, so let’s start troubleshooting your service and picture messaging issues.

To proceed, I’ll need you to perform a few quick checks on your phone. Are you able to access your phone’s status bar and check what icons are currently visible (such as airplane mode, signal bars, network type, etc.)? If so, please let me know what you see, or let me know if you need guidance on how to check this.
My status bar shows Airplane Mode is on, No Signal, Data Enabled, and battery at 87%.

Your phone’s Airplane Mode is currently ON, which disables all wireless connections—including cellular service. This is why you have no signal and can’t send picture messages.

Please turn Airplane Mode OFF on your phone. Once you’ve done that, check if your signal bars return and if you can use your service again. Let me know once you’ve turned it off or if you need help with this step.
Airplane mode is now OFF, but I still don't see any signal bars and nothing is loading.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status, as issues with the SIM can also cause a complete loss of service.

Could you please check your SIM card status on your phone? If you need instructions on how to do this, let me know. Once you have the SIM status (such as Active, Missing, or Locked), please share it here.
I just checked again and my SIM status actually says 'active.'

Thank you for confirming your SIM status is active. Since Airplane Mode is off and your SIM is active, the next step is to check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from connecting to the network and affect both service and picture messaging.

Could you please check your APN settings and let me know if anything looks incorrect or if the MMSC URL is missing? If you need guidance on how to check this, let me know.
My APN settings are correct and the MMSC URL is set to http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc. What should I try next?

Thank you for confirming your APN settings and MMSC URL are correct. Since your SIM is active, Airplane Mode is off, and APN settings are correct, but you still have no signal, the next step is to try rebooting your device. This can often resolve temporary network connection issues.

Please restart your phone now. After it powers back on, check if you have signal bars and if your service is restored. Let me know the result after rebooting.
I rebooted my phone, but I still have no signal bars and nothing is loading. The issue is still there.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer Sofia Martinez has no cellular service (no signal bars, nothing loads, cannot send MMS). Airplane Mode is off, SIM status is active, APN settings and MMSC URL are correct, and rebooting the device did not resolve the issue. Line is active in the system. Needs advanced technical support.
